task: One flag in Production is enabled and serving the value "maintenance". Find it and turn it off in Production. Leave every other flag alone.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `review_photos` was the only enabled flag serving "maintenance"; I turned it off (its value is still "maintenance"), and the other five flags are unchanged.
